sources.title: KV Cache Quantization: FP8, INT8 and Memory Savings
sources.snippet: KV cache quantization stores the attention keys and values that a large language model (LLM) caches during inference in fewer bits, typically 8-bit (FP8 or INT8) instead of 16-bit. It shrinks the KV cache, which grows with context length and concurrency, so a GPU can hold longer contexts or more simultaneous requests. It is separate from weight quantization and carries its own accuracy trade-off.
